metadata.description: Cowork-first starter scaffolding: process discipline, knowledge management, delegation patterns, a personal-companion track, a personalized daily news digest, and a fintech regulatory issue-spotter. Distributed as zips attached to GitHub releases — install via Cowork's Customize → Browse plugins → upload custom plugin file. Works for any kind of structured work, not just coding.

plugins.name: welcome
plugins.description: Top-level marketplace orientation. One slash command (/welcome:tour) plus a value-first opening that names three concrete user moments (decide / reflect / fintech triage) and invites the user into theirs, in any language. No upfront feature list; catalog only on request. Read-only — writes nothing, invokes nothing without consent. Recommended first install for new users.

plugins.name: process-skills
plugins.description: Six domain-agnostic process skills: brainstorming (idea → validated design), planning-projects (staged plan with gates), executing-plans (drive a plan to done with evidence-of-done), evidence-first-investigation (figure out why before proposing what), review-document (holistic 30-second-rule review), peer-review-deliverable (review what's new against a baseline). Plus /process-skills:tour for the read-only walkthrough.

plugins.name: vault-librarian
plugins.description: Companion to the upstream obsidian-wiki plugin. One cross-platform slash command (/vault-librarian:bootstrap-vault) that sets up a Markdown notes vault from inside Claude Code, with persona-tuned schema templates for researchers, writers, generalists, and personal users. No shell snippets — works on Claude Code Desktop and Claude Cowork on macOS and Windows.

plugins.name: delegation-agents
plugins.description: Three model-pinned worker subagents (bulk-reader on Haiku, document-rewriter and draft-generator on Sonnet) plus a dispatching-parallel-agents skill. Lets a parent session on Opus offload bulk reading, editing, and drafting to cheaper, faster models. Domain-agnostic — works for research, writing, project management, analysis.

plugins.name: personal-coach
plugins.description: Personal-use companion: persistent profile across sessions, CBT-style reflection (not therapy), business-decision frames with grading, morning briefing. Value-first onboarding — one short opening, then engages a real situation. Auto-bootstraps its own notes vault on first save (no separate command needed). Multilingual. Hard limits enforced. News digest and fintech legal triage now live in their own companion plugins (news-digest, fintech-legal-advisor) — install those alongside if you want either.

plugins.name: news-digest
plugins.description: Personalized daily news digest for Claude Cowork. Two skills (news-preferences + news-digest) and one setup command. Captures topics, sources, exclusions, language, format, cadence, and an open-questions watchlist; produces a dated digest filtered strictly against those preferences. Refuses generic headlines — without preferences, the digest does not run. Cites every item; never fabricates. Works standalone; integrates softly with personal-coach (morning-briefing pairing) and vault-librarian (vault path) when installed.

plugins.name: fintech-legal-advisor
plugins.description: Fintech regulatory issue-spotter for Claude Cowork — KYC/AML, payment licensing, MiCA / crypto, GDPR, customer contracts, marketing claims, sanctions exposure. A fintech-specific complement to Anthropic's Claude for Legal (whose practice-area plugins cover general commercial / corporate / privacy / IP / litigation, but not fintech regulation). When Claude for Legal MCP connectors are granted, the plugin prefers them: Westlaw / Practical Law for live primary-law verification; Box / iManage / NetDocuments / Docusign as contract sources; Microsoft Word for tracked-change output. Citation grounding is a hard rule — every named regulation is verified against a live source or flagged confidence:low. Setup command wires a Cowork Routine on the chosen source for high-volume non-sensitive triage. Issue lists, never verdicts. Take-to-counsel block on every output. Not legal advice.
